recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片細胞密集，大多數是核圓、胞質少的原始細胞，大小從小型到中大型不一，混有少數分葉中性球與有核紅血球；此原始細胞片狀增生符合 ALL，T 細胞系需免疫表型確認。
features: Blasts vary from small to medium-large with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli visible in larger cells
Scattered residual neutrophils, erythroid precursors and smudged cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power is hypercellular and composed predominantly of blasts ranging from small to medium-large, with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin, variably visible nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. Residual neutrophils and erythroid precursors are sparse, and scattered smudged cells are present. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; T-lymphoblastic leukemia should be confirmed by flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, CD7, TdT).

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; separated by B-lineage versus T-lineage antigen expression.
Myeloblasts are larger with more cytoplasm, granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive.
Hematogones show a spectrum of maturation with homogeneous condensed chromatin and a normal, maturing B-cell immunophenotypic pattern.
